data.gender_notes: Rodge is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Rodge is recorded in name-lists as “Ruler of the rods”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rodge expresses “Ruler of the rods”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rodge total 31, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.

in_hebrew.name: רודג
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word 'rod' (רוד) meaning 'to see', this name could mean 'seeing a rod' or 'a seer with a rod'. The name is not found in the Bible.

in_greek.name: Ροδγος
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'ροδος' (rhodos) meaning 'a rod', this name could mean 'rod-bearer' or 'rod-carrier'. The name is not found in the Bible.

in_latin.name: Rodgus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'roddus' derived from 'roddus' meaning 'rod'. The name is not found in the Bible.
